message.abstract:
<jats:p>
            We introduce Kleene algebra with tests, an equational system for manipulating programs. We give a purely equational proof, using Kleene algebra with tests and commutativity conditions, of the following classical result: every
            <jats:bold>while</jats:bold>
            program can be simulated by a while program can be simulated by a
            <jats:bold>while</jats:bold>
            program with at most one
            <jats:bold>while</jats:bold>
            loop. The proof illustrates the use of Kleene algebra with tests and commutativity conditions in program equivalence proofs.
          </jats:p>
title: Kleene algebra with tests
